Благодарю вас, сэр.\nИ клерк положил оба листа рядом и усердно сравнил их содержимое.\n— Благодарю вас, сэр, — сказал он наконец, возвращая оба, — это очень интересный автограф.", "source_sha256": "201cc70a0c65d85ad2f83a5b9fa212c5b58dfb2561b1b9316b1094a74bef6029", "target_id": "ru-en94-05-031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f69359aeda3a0719a5dd5fe1f4912f988e48f6e9bd85785038aa6e43dacd716b"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": null, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en94-05-032", "text": "There was a pause, during which Mr. Utterson struggled with himself. “Why did you compare them, Guest?” he inquired suddenly.", "sha256": "770ef4af8948af61276700e1f2c5b8264bcbe5cdf0f2ecef07df3f5173cdeaff", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}, {"id": "en94-05-033", "text": "“Well, sir,” returned the clerk, “there’s a rather singular resemblance; the two hands are in many points identical: only differently sloped.”", "sha256": "be08c7d0a3d744111b6b0835f41a9a5921d9740e0ea9d57db6e3732ec6efc97b", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}, {"id": "en94-05-034", "text": "“Rather quaint,” said Utterson.", "sha256": "f388fbe5a596e895a1a833ef865b691c8617445284475160d51445a5535eb55d", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}, {"id": "en94-05-035", "text": "“It is, as you say, rather quaint,” returned Guest.", "sha256": "6b8c8a23c277b08847dbda0b4047cee69ff4c2d786c31ddd3d2e3570138c2bc1", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}, {"id": "en94-05-036", "text": "“I wouldn’t speak of this note, you know,” said the master.", "sha256": "2620d11941b3e8b451a91d3b6e4be0fdff0885620f8a415182c65421d1b28f8f", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}, {"id": "en94-05-037", "text": "“No, sir,” said the clerk. “I understand.”", "sha256": "a2771d98fdbafc319849be4ed795ed78a3ed885dedba2868300a79c8d8b02a06", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}, {"id": "en94-05-038", "text": "But no sooner was Mr. Utterson alone that night than he locked the note into his safe, where it reposed from that time forward. “What!” he thought. “Henry Jekyll forge for a murderer!” And his blood ran cold in his veins.", "sha256": "caf0615a4b32f6c67193a691409ee6085cf6c21dd6ee6b2f8ad1897c99cb33cf", "tag": "p", "role": "prose", "source_class": null, "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "br_count": 0}]}
